questions.q: Why was one field left fallow?
questions.a: To let the soil rest and recover
A tenth of crops given to the Church

questions.q: Name two buildings in a manor.
questions.a: For example: manor house and mill

questions.q: Core: Label the manor map, then write a diary entry for one day in a villein's year (spring sowing or autumn harvest) in the portal response box.
questions.a: Correct labels; a diary using villein, strip, lord's land, tithe

questions.q: Extend: Compare a villein's home with yours (two differences).
questions.a: For example: wattle and daub walls, no running water

questions.q: Stretch: Why might a villein want to leave the manor?
questions.a: To be free, earn wages and not work for the lord

questions.q: A field left empty for a year is:
questions.a: B) Fallow. Fallow land rests for a year so the soil recovers.

questions.q: Big question: would you swap for a day? Why?
questions.a: A choice with reasons using village facts
